LanguageData.ABY_DominionBreachDriver_ProfileDesc: Repeated confirmed blows force a target-specific pressure sequence instead of adding general crowd damage.
LanguageData.ABY_DominionBreachDriver_SequenceDesc: Switching targets or losing contact for too long resets the sequence.
LanguageData.ABY_DominionBreachDriver_SentenceDesc: The third confirmed hit adds a separate high-penetration impact against the same living pawn.
LanguageData.ABY_DominionBreachDriver_LimitsValue: Living pawns only; one active target
LanguageData.ABY_DominionBreachDriver_LimitsDesc: The driver does not build verdict pressure on buildings, corpses, or multiple targets at once.
